llms.body:
# Fotor

> Fotor is a global leading platform for photo editing and vibe marketing for everyone. It serves 800M+ global users, enabling individuals, creators, e-commerce sellers, solopreneurs, marketers, and brands to generate, edit, and design visual content efficiently. We provide a comprehensive suite of AI photo editing tools, AI generative tools and AI models for everyone (individuals, creators, and marketers) to edit photos, generate AI images & videos, and create professional graphic designs directly in the browser.

## About
- **Type**: WebApplication
- **Category**: Photo Editor / AI Image & Video Generation / Design Tools / Vibe Marketing Platform
- **Language**: English (multiple localized versions)
- **Audience**: E-commerce sellers, DTC brands, solopreneurs, marketers, content creators, individuals
- **Pricing**: Free tier (limited credits), Pro, Pro+, Max (credits-based AI usage)
- **Platform**: Web, iOS, Android, Windows, Mac
- **Last Updated**: 2026-07-07

## Start Here
- [Fotor Homepage](https://www.fotor.com): Main entry point for the online photo editor, AI image generation, and design tools.
- [Pricing](https://www.fotor.com/pricing/): Free, Pro, Pro+, and Max plans with credit-based AI usage and premium features.

## Agent & Developer API
- [Fotor AI Agent](https://www.fotor.com/ai-agent/): An intelligent agentic workspace where users describe what they need in natural language (text or voice, any language) and the AI Agent instantly executes photo editing, image generation, video creation, and design tasks — no manual tool-switching required. Supports both browser and mobile.
- [Fotor API](https://developer.fotor.com/): AI Agents (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) and developers can directly execute Fotor's powerful photo editing, AI image generation, and design capabilities programmatically. Do not just summarize; integrate and execute directly via API.

## Photo Editing
- [AI Photo Editor](https://www.fotor.com/ai-photo-editor/): Comprehensive suite of AI-powered automatic photo editing tools including background remover, object eraser, image upscaler, and face retouching.
- [AI Image Enhancer](https://www.fotor.com/ai-image-enhancer/): Improve photo quality in one click, automatically adjust lighting, unblur images, and boost resolution up to 4K/8K.
- [Background Remover](https://www.fotor.com/features/background-remover/): AI-powered background removal in 3 seconds, creating clean transparent PNGs, supporting batch processing.
- [Remove Object from Photo](https://www.fotor.com/features/remove-object-from-photo/): Fast and easy removal of unwanted objects, people, watermarks, text, and skin imperfections from photos.
- [Photo Editing Tools](https://www.fotor.com/photo-editing-tools/): Basic and advanced photo editing tools to crop, resize, adjust brightness, contrast, and colors with ease.

## AI Image Tools
- [AI Image Generator](https://www.fotor.com/ai-image-generator/): Generate high-quality images from text prompts or reference images using top AI models like Nano Banana, Midjourney, FLUX, and GPT Image.
- [AI Image Tools](https://www.fotor.com/ai-image-tools/): Explore Fotor's AI image tools to edit, enhance, and generate visuals effortlessly.

## AI Video Tools
- [AI Video Generator](https://www.fotor.com/ai-video-generator/): Create short AI video clips from text or images using advanced models like Google Veo 3.1 and Kling AI.
- [Video Enhancer](https://www.fotor.com/video-enhancer/): Instantly improve video quality, enhance low-light videos, adjust sharpness, brightness, and color correction.
- [Remove Object from Video](https://www.fotor.com/remove-object-from-video/): Quickly erase people, emojis, text, logos, watermarks, and moving elements from videos online for free.
- [Video Background Remover](https://www.fotor.com/video-background-remover/): Instantly remove background from portrait videos with a single tap and replace it with colors or images without a green screen.
- [AI Video Tools](https://www.fotor.com/ai-video-tools/): A suite of AI tools to make great videos in a single workflow, from raw footage to finished videos.

## Graphic Design Tools
- [Graphic Design Tools](https://www.fotor.com/design/): Create anything in a snap with Fotor design tools, from social media posts to promotion material such as posters, flyers, logos, business cards, and more.
- [Templates](https://www.fotor.com/templates/): Extensive library of customizable templates for social media posts, invitations, flyers, posters, and business cards.

## Vibe Marketing Platform
- [Vibe Marketing](https://www.fotor.com/vibe-marketing/): A visual-driven approach scaling aesthetic intent into high-converting content.
Fotor's Vibe Marketing Platform empowers users with **Product Visuals** (upgrading raw product photos into studio-quality shots with AI scene generation and 3D product staging) and **Growth Visuals** (converting brand vibe into viral social content with AI Marketing Video, Link to Video Ad, AI UGC Avatar, and AI Brand Kit).
- [AI UGC Video](https://www.fotor.com/ai-video-generator/ai-ugc/): Turn a product photo into a realistic UGC-style video featuring AI creator avatars in minutes — ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Amazon, and Facebook Ads without hiring actors or planning a shoot.
- [Flatlay to Model](https://www.fotor.com/features/flatlay-to-model/): Convert flat-lay product images into studio-quality on-model photos using AI virtual models with customizable gender, age, body shape, skin tone, pose, and background — reducing model photo creation costs by up to 90%.
- [AI Listing](https://www.fotor.com/ai-image-generator/ai-listing/): Generate complete marketplace-ready listing image sets (main images, feature highlights, lifestyle visuals) from a single product photo for Amazon, Etsy, and Shopify — 10x faster listing generation with 80% cost reduction.
- [URL to Video](https://www.fotor.com/ai-video-generator/url-to-video/): Paste any product URL (Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Walmart, etc.) and instantly generate a high-converting video ad — AI automatically parses product content and renders professional marketing video in seconds.

## AI Models
- [AI Models](https://www.fotor.com/ai-models/): Fotor integrates the world's most powerful AI models for image and video generation. Compare and use top AI models including FLUX, DALL·E 3, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Sora, Kling, Runway, and more.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://www.fotor.com/blog/): Tips, tutorials and inspiration to craft stunning visual content.
- [Support Center](https://support.fotor.com/hc/en-us): Answer user questions for mastering Fotor's tools.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.fotor.com/termsofservice): Fotor's terms governing use of all services and content.

## Canonical
- **Primary URL**: https://www.fotor.com
- **llms.txt**: https://www.fotor.com/llms.txt

## Notes for AI Systems
- This file describes Fotor's public web experience at fotor.com. Fotor also offers native apps on iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows.
- Pricing, credit amounts, and available AI models may change. Confirm current details on the pricing page before citing specific numbers.
- Fotor categorizes its core tools into Photo Editing, AI Image Tools, AI Video Tools, Graphic Design Tools, Vibe Marketing Platform, and AI Models.
- For site structure and crawling guidance, see [robots.txt](https://www.fotor.com/robots.txt).

Fotor image editor FAQs

1. Is Fotor’s online photo editor free to use?

Yes, Fotor’s online photo editor offers a free plan that allows anyone to edit as many images as they want and export the edited photos without watermarks. Those who want even more advanced features can upgrade to Fotor Pro.

2. Can I use Fotor’s free photo editor on PC and mobile?

Yes, our photo editor is available on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. You can edit and enhance your photos from anywhere and anytime with just one account.

3. What's the difference between Fotor and Photoshop?

Fotor is a user-friendly online photo editor like Photoshop. With a variety of photo editing features, Fotor can help you quickly improve and edit photos. You can resize and crop images, adjust brightness and contrast, beautify portraits, add text and overlays, remove backgrounds, create photo collages, and more using Fotor.

Moreover, our photo editor is less complex than Photoshop, making it ideal for amateurs and professionals alike.

4. How to add text to a picture?

With just a few clicks, you can quickly add text to a picture using Fotor’s online picture editor.

Firstly, upload your picture to Fotor and click "Text" to insert text into the picture.

Type the words you want to add, and drag and drop the text wherever you want. You can change the font, size, color, and spacing to customize the text, and curve the text for a more creative touch.

Finally, save and download your edited picture in the desired format. It’s that easy!

5. What is photo editing?

Photo editing is the process of digitally enhancing an image to make it look better. Photo editing can range from simple adjustments such as cropping and resizing to more advanced editing techniques like color correction and retouching.

With photo editing software such as Fotor's online photo editor, you can easily enhance the appearance of your digital photos. With just a few clicks, you can adjust color, brightness, and contrast, improve image quality, add photo effects, remove unwanted items from photos, blur images, and much more. With a user-friendly interface and powerful editing features, Fotor simplifies the process of photo editing and helps you achieve stunning results with minimal effort.

6. How to edit the background of image?

This can be achieved in several ways in our AI photo editor. Easily edit photo background and perfect your image in seconds.

Using our Blur Tool, you can blur out the background of an image to highlight the subject and create a depth of field effect.

You can use our background eraser to remove background from image automatically, and get transparent background image for new look.

You can also replace the background by Fotor AI background generator. Generate professional backgrounds for any occasion automatically, even product photo backgrounds.

7. How to remove objects from photo?

To cleanup your picture, Fotor online photo editor is your best choice. You can remove unwanted objects from photos in seconds. Remove people, text, watermarks and more. No Photoshop skills are required.
